record.title: ST VL53L8CX — 8x8 multizone Time-of-Flight sensor, 1.8 V core, IOVDD 1.2/1.8 V only, I2C/SPI, optical LGA16
record.why: electrical identity and figures are vendor-cited in iterations/v0.0.1/electrical.*.json (that record's own verdict is PASS); the mechanical side — cad/interfaces.json names no frame, cad/part.py builds no geometry — was not measured in this lane, so the folder cannot grade itself better than CANNOT DETERMINE. What settles it: a package-outline frame read off the datasheet's mechanical drawing and a part.py that builds it.
record.origin_why: every electrical figure was read off ST's own PDF (DS14161 Rev 12, July 2025), fetched 2026-09-02 from st.com, sha256 in iterations/v0.0.1/PROVENANCE.json
